name: Native rodents & small mammals
description: Small native mammals - the long-tailed mouse colilargo (Oligoryzomys longicaudatus, the web's fourth most-connected node), grass mice (Abrothrix), tuco-tucos (Chelemys, Eligomodontia), the leaf-eared mouse Phyllotis and the wetland coypu coipo (Myocastor coypus). Functional group pooling 7 source nodes (6 native, 0 exotic, 1 mixed-origin); all are granivore/herbivore prey leveled as primary consumers, eaten by virtually every predator in the web.
